params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $before=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  Write-Output "VERIFY_HEAD=$before"
  Write-Output 'PRE_STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short --branch; Write-Output 'PRE_STATUS_END'
  & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Verify-Release.ps1
  $code=$LASTEXITCODE
  Write-Output "VERIFY_EXIT=$code"
  Write-Output 'POST_STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short; Write-Output 'POST_STATUS_END'
  $after=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  Write-Output "VERIFY_HEAD_AFTER=$after"
  if($code -ne 0){ exit $code }
} finally { Pop-Location }
